infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: 3C Onyx uses your camera to scan and document vehicle condition for the 360° Vehicle Scanner and secure document vault.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: 3C Onyx accesses your photo library to upload vehicle photos and documents to your secure vault.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: 3C Onyx saves scanned vehicle images to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: 3C Onyx uses your contacts to help you invite colleagues and friends to your referral network.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: 3C Onyx uses your location to find nearby auto businesses, roadside assistance providers, and fuel stations.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: 3C Onyx may use your microphone for voice-enabled features within the app.
